text:
Zoe (Mktg): Quick brief for next webinar + launch blog  need a compact visual kit by Tue AM: 1) tri-fold PDF one-pager (print + email), 2) animated email header GIF (600x200, loop ~6s), 3) two micro-infographics (routing flow & cost-vs-latency scatter), 4) LinkedIn hero A/B variants (short+long copy), 5) localized PNGs for FR/DE/JP. Also need alt text for all assets and WCAG color-contrast check.

Theo (Design): Ok. Bandwidth Wed morning only. Can you drop exact headline, stat, and any benchmark axis labels? Also confirm Figma path.

Carmen (PMM): Headline: "Predictable inference economics you can plan for." Stat: "~2.3x unit cost reduction vs naive serving w/ batching + KV cache (internal benchmark)". Chart axis: x=latency (ms), y=cost per 1k tokens ($). Figma: https://figma.com/redwood/launch-kit (assets/marketing/inference).

Arjun (Webinar): For the animated header, we want a micro-anim: sparkline rising then dropping when cache + batching kicks in, label callouts at 2s and 4s. GIF should include silent caption overlay: "See live demo".

Theo (Design): Noted. For tri-fold, do we want fold guides and printer bleed?

Zoe (Mktg): Yes 0.125in bleed, CMYK-safe colors, and include a short QR linking to demo sign-up. Also create a single-page print-friendly B&W variant.

Mei (Legal): Legal note: include this exact footnote on any stats or charts: "Internal benchmark on representative test workload; actual results vary by model and traffic patterns." Also include data handling copy for the PDF footer: "No customer data used in benchmarks." Approve pending those additions.

Carmen (PMM): Adding SDR crib (short bullets) to Figma comments: 3 top talking points, 1 sentence routing spiel, demo link.

Theo (Design): Will add alt text strings in the Figma components and run contrast check. Plan: first-pass PNGs + GIF mock Tue 9:30AM, tri-fold PDF draft Tue 3PM. I'll upload localized label files; Carmen, please provide translated short copy for FR/DE/JP by Mon EOD.

AssetBot: Auto-check: "Contrast check pending on primary CTA color (#0A84FF)"

Zoe (Mktg): Translators pinged. Owners: Theo (design), Carmen (copy + translations), Mei (legal). If design is in by Tue noon we can lock for Wed blog publish. Thanks! :rocket:
